name: Young Men
overview: Scripture presents young men as active participants in the worship and leadership life of Israel, as seen when Moses sent young men to offer sacrifices to the LORD (Exodus 24:5). The counsel young men give is contrasted with that of the elders, exemplified by King Rehoboam who rejected the advice of the older men and instead followed the counsel of his peers (1 Kings 12:6-8). These passages highlight the significance of young men's roles in both religious service and decision-making, underscoring the need for godly wisdom and obedience in their actions.
